topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Sure, pensions weren't made fornev, but every now and then, you come across something that makes all the rain and shadows fade a bit. Your neighbor, Mr. Ellis, with his worn hands and gentle smile, asked if he could borrow a patch of your yard for a garden. It’s a small request, really, in a world where the big asks have all gone unanswered. You see the hope in his eyes, the kind of hope that’s as rare as a dry sidewalk on a misty morning. So you nod, and tell him it’s all right. You even offer a little help, maybe some seeds or a tool or two. ’Cause sometimes, in this hard city, a little green can go a long way.
